issue: Below the hero, the three styles of each surface follow one section order with new labels. appmeta-a ≡ appmeta-b, gymlogger-x-a ≡ -b ≡ -c, rightsplit-b ≡ -c, shogiful-b ≡ -c, wanderwiki-a ≡ -b (-c swaps two blocks) and pawza-a ≡ -c. The xiangqiful, earnlock and millrace trios each differ by one swap. Across the 60 microsite styles, one order dominates: hero → quick answer → (quick reference) → how it works → screenshots → features → who_for/who_not_for → price → comparison → privacy → founder/about → (roadmap) → FAQ → further reading → closing. That is one static structure in 60 costumes, which is the thing the owner refused ('do not use the same static structure for each page, build them from scratch'). It also makes the three styles per page skin choices, not page choices.
fix: Re-derive every visitorPath from the world's own reading order, and enforce two rules. (1) Within a surface, no two styles may share the relative order of more than two of {price, screenshots, comparison, privacy record, founder, FAQ}. (2) At least one style per surface must change GROUPING, not just order: for example, FAQ split into the sections it answers, who_for/who_not_for folded into the price, or the privacy record as the opener. World-native examples: tare-b sets Puzzle No. 1 before the Rules and puts price and answers at the back like a book. studio-a, allpaid-c and rightsplit-a open with the record (bin label, statement, label data) before any feature. soon-b prints the fare and stub (price) on the face, first. gymlogger-x-c shows the plateau formula before any offer. xiangqiful-c files each FAQ as a margin question on the entry it concerns. observa-b ends on 'past issues' (release notes) instead of a closing CTA block. The maker/freshness line and the shared footer strip may stay common.

issue: The Back Catalogue's cloudberry drench (#F2B21B) is almost the same yellow as taskful-day-c's timer body (#F4C443). It also sits beside allpaid-a's poster yellow (#FFD617). All three set black type with white panels. If the studio wears a microsite's drench, that microsite reads as the studio, and the studio as the microsite.
fix: Drop the drench on studio-b. The shop wall goes neutral (white, or a graphite shelf), so the spines in each app's own colours are the only colour. That is also truer to its thesis that the label appears only as a catalogue number and a cartouche. allpaid-a (Abfahrt yellow) and taskful-day-c (the icon's sun) keep yellow. If both are picked, keep taskful-day-c's white dial face dominant.

issue: The Open Depot's first viewport repeats liftlog-a's. The Open Depot has a concrete ground (#E6E8E5), full-height steel uprights at the page edges, and full-width coloured beams crossing the page that carry the section titles. liftlog-a has a concrete ground (#E4E4E0), a full-height steel shaft at the left edge, and full-width coloured plate slabs crossing the page that carry the section titles. Its beam orange (#E2560F, ~30% of the surface, including a full-bleed orange masthead) also matches wanderwiki-b's orange backing-card drench (#E8622A).
fix: liftlog-a keeps the edge member and the crossing bands, which are the literal bar and plates. studio-a moves to the white-painted depot its own scene describes (ground ~#F3F4F1). It shows the racking as one bay frame around the location index, not as page-edge rails. Orange stays on beam labels and pick tickets: no full-bleed orange masthead or aisle band.

issue: The Big Shoulders family is a display face in three surfaces: Big Shoulders Stencil Display (studio-a H1), Big Shoulders Display 800 (gymlogger-x-a door lettering) and Big Shoulders Display 800/600 (taskful-day-a letter tiles). The Stencil cut is the same skeleton, and the studio should share no display family with any microsite.
fix: Keep Big Shoulders Display on gymlogger-x-a, where municipal locker plates are its native register. studio-a sets its stencil in Allerta Stencil, which is unused on the board; it has one weight, so the 150px size carries it. taskful-day-a leaves the family with its replacement world (see the taskful-day-a issue).

issue: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is the text face in seven surfaces: studio-a, aftershift-a, allpaid-b, appmeta-pulse-a, mediakit-b, observa-a and shogiful-b. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is the data face in four: aftershift-a, allpaid-b, observa-a and shogiful-b. This monoculture will make the microsites read alike below their heroes.
fix: Keep it on two surfaces: aftershift-a (low acuity after a night shift) and allpaid-b (display and text, read from across the room). Swap the rest. studio-a → Work Sans. appmeta-pulse-a → B612 400/700 for text, one cockpit family with its display and B612 Mono. mediakit-b → Overpass 400/700 for text, one family with its display. observa-a → League Spartan with tabular figures and no mono (see the observa-a issue). shogiful-b → Murecho 400/600 for the commentary, with tabular figures for notation.

issue: Familjen Grotesk is the text face of both studio-b and observa-c, and no microsite should share the studio's reading face.
fix: studio-b keeps it. Set observa-c's text in Be Vietnam Pro 400/600 (unused) with tabular figures.

issue: Raster weight is unbudgeted everywhere. Every microsite puts the app icon in its nav or hero at 24 to 72px, and most put screenshots in carousels or heroes. The only files that exist are 1024px icon PNGs of 0.56 to 3.96 MB (mediakit.png is 3.96 MB; lagerland-mark.png is 1.96 MB, and the current header already ships it at 30px) and 1206x2622 screenshot PNGs of 0.3 to 7.6 MB (soon/2.png is 7.6 MB, mediakit/2.png is 7.1 MB). Nearly every card says assetsNeeded: none, so no style accounts for derivatives. Shipped as-is, a 390px page downloads several MB before the badge is usable.
fix: Add one production task to every style: a one-off script in scripts/ (already excluded from the build, so it is not a deploy build step) that commits derivatives. Icons at 64, 128 and 256px (WebP plus a PNG fallback, about 15 KB or less at 128). Screenshots at 400w, 800w and 1200w WebP (about 40, 90 and 160 KB or less). The studio mark as the clean SVG that studio a/b/c already ask for. Front matter keeps the original paths; one include maps them to the derivatives and emits width/height, srcset/sizes, loading=lazy and decoding=async (eager plus fetchpriority=high only for a single hero image).

issue: Sticky bars hide focus (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.4.11). Every style adds a sticky download bar after the hero, and most also pin a top strip; earnlock-c also fixes side rims, shogiful-a keeps a tag rail and soon-a an earth bar. A focused link, FAQ summary or #anchor target can land underneath them. On a Safari viewport of about 664px, two 52 to 64px bars plus the Smart App Banner can cover more than a quarter of the screen.
fix: Make it a global contract: html { scroll-padding-top: var(--sticky-top); scroll-padding-bottom: var(--sticky-bottom) }, so focus and anchors never land under a bar. Allow one sticky element per edge, pad the bottom bar with env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and on viewports shorter than 600px hide the top strip while the bottom bar is showing.

issue: Accessibility and weight. Typing three digits anywhere on the page navigates. That is a single-character shortcut, which fails WCAG 2.1.4 (Level A) unless it can be turned off or only works with focus on a control, and it collides with screen-reader quick keys. The header clock ticks every second and the cursor blinks every second indefinitely; WCAG 2.2.2 requires a pause for blinking that lasts more than 5s. The server-rendered clock would show the Jekyll build time as if it were live. MIX uses the 1024px icon PNGs (0.56 to 3.96 MB each) as hover backgrounds, so skimming the index downloads tens of MB.
fix: Listen for digits only in the visible PAGE field (render it on desktop too) and in one focusable index region, never at document level. Blink the cursor three times, then hold it. The clock shows minutes only; it is server-rendered with the label 'page built' plus the build date, and JS replaces it with the local time. MIX uses 480px WebP derivatives (about 30 to 50 KB) through image-set(), loaded only for the hovered or focused line.

issue: Monoculture: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next appears on seven surfaces (studio-a, aftershift-a, allpaid-b, appmeta-pulse-a, mediakit-b, observa-a, shogiful-b), and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono on four. The two kept are aftershift-a, where the scene of reading 13 hours into a night shift justifies it, and allpaid-b, where it is the whole identity.
fix: Set studio-a's text in Gantari 400/700/400i (about 31 KB). Martian Mono stays for data only.

issue: Layout shift from huge display headlines. Many heroes set 100 to 128px condensed or expanded H1s (millrace-c Antonio at 128px, soon-b at 128px, allpaid-a at 112px, gymlogger-x-a at 112px, liftlog-a at wdth 125). When the font swaps in from a system fallback with very different widths, the H1 reflows and the hero shifts.
fix: For each display face, declare a metric-matched fallback @font-face (size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override over a local system face), preload only the display file, and use font-display: swap for text faces and optional for the giant H1 face.

issue: Shared skeleton: after gymlogger-x-a moves off it, the Big Shoulders design still serves studio-a (Stencil Display) and taskful-day-a (Display). If both win, the studio and one microsite share a headline skeleton.
fix: Acceptable at two surfaces, because the stencil cut reads differently from plain marquee tiles. If both are picked, give taskful-day-a's tiles the 600 weight and keep the 800 weight for studio-a.

issue: The homepage is a Persuade surface, but no App Store badge or QR is visible anywhere on it without interaction. The card itself says 'No badge or QR is in the first viewport: they live in each row's pulled-out box', and those boxes are closed <details> drawers. 'Goods in', the newest release, shows a screenshot and date but no badge.
fix: Give 'Goods in' an always-visible badge (and the QR at 1024px and up) for the newest arrival. Place it within 1440×900 and 390×844, e.g. as a white bin label beside the stocktake strip, so one working App Store action shows without opening a drawer.

issue: Every studio card adds the Smart App Banner to 'journal posts and guides with exactly one mentioned app'. The contract says the banner is unaffected, and head.html emits it only on layout app. plan.json lists this as an open owner question.
fix: Keep head.html's current rule in the studio cards. Re-add the journal and guide banner only if the owner answers the open question yes.

issue: The stocktake and newsflash strips read 'MANIFESTS 18 + 1 PENDING'. transparency.yml splits this as 11 source-verified, 7 App Store-declared ('submission') and 1 pending. '18 manifests' implies 18 read from source, which overstates what the record proves.
fix: Compute and print the three states the record uses: '11 source-verified · 7 App Store-declared · 1 pending', grouped by manifest_source, as a's /transparency/ read mode already labels them.

issue: At 390 there is no App Store badge in the first viewport. In b the face-out sleeve appears only on tap; in c, MIX and the subtitle panel are off on phones. Desktop is fine in both.
fix: b: render the newest release face-out by default on phones, with the sleeve and badge directly under the lede. c: show the newest app's subtitle panel (tagline, price, badge) under the keypad row on phones.

issue: Each app's tagline and price.value appear only in the MIX subtitle panel, on hover or focus of its need-line. Phones never see them on P100, and crawlers get them only as hover-state text.
fix: Print each app's tagline and price.value on its need-line (a second line on phones). MIX may enlarge them but must not be their only home.
